summary: Key demands by the BMS include hike in variable DA, a minimum monthly wage of ₹30,000 for unskilled workers, job security for contract workers, higher pensions and increased wage ceilings for EPF and ESLI schemes.&nbsp;

title: Kisan Vikas Patra at 7.5%: How long will your money take to double in 2026?
summary: Kisan Vikas Patra offers a 7.5% annual interest rate in July-September 2026, with investments doubling in 115 months. Here is how KVP works, its maturity period, investment limits and key points savers should know before investing.

title: CBDT’s foreign income-asset disclosure scheme for small taxpayers: How much income tax do you actually have to pay?
summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes launched a one-time scheme on 16 August for small taxpayers to declare undisclosed foreign assets until December 2026. A 60% payment on the declared value ensures immunity from penalties.

summary: Employees with multiple jobs may receive separate EPF benefits from each employer, and EPFO provides guidelines for overlapping employment. Details here.&nbsp;

title: Home loan prepayment vs investing: When should you use extra cash to repay debt?
summary: Home loan prepayment can reduce interest costs, while investing surplus funds may offer higher returns. Compare the loan rate, post-tax investment gains, risk and liquidity before deciding.&nbsp;

title: Credit card statement date vs payment due date: What is the difference, and why does it matter
summary: Check out the difference between a credit card statement date and payment due date. Having a clear understanding of the same can help cardholders plan repayments, avoid late fees and interest, manage cash flow and maintain healthier credit habits.

title: RBI proposes 3-month MCLR reset for loans: What could change for borrowers and their monthly EMIs
summary: RBI has proposed a new MCLR formula using a three-month moving average of banks’ marginal funding costs. The draft also proposes a three-month reset period for MCLR-linked loans and aims to make loan pricing more transparent.

title: Why life insurance should be part of your financial freedom plan, not an afterthought
summary: Financial freedom requires more than wealth creation. Learn how life insurance, emergency savings and disciplined SIP investing can protect family finances, support long-term goals and build a stronger financial plan against unexpected life events.

title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
summary: Madhusudan Kela’s disclosed portfolio of 19 stocks was worth about Rs 2,665 crore as of August 14. Seven holdings gained 10–135% in 2026, while five declined 15–30%, highlighting sharply divergent performances.

title: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
summary: Bitcoin hovered near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and a cancelled SEC meeting weighed on crypto sentiment. Bitcoin and Ethereum declined, while the global crypto market cap slipped 0.4%. Analysts cited subdued momentum, regulatory uncertainty and range-bound trading.

title: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
summary: Nifty remains range-bound amid falling volatility, with 24,200–24,150 as key support and 24,550–24,600 as resistance. Options data shows strong Put writing, suggesting limited downside. Analysts prefer PSU banks, while defence, auto and chemicals remain technically strong.

title: IPO rush: 5 companies to raise Rs 5,499 crore next week; Shiprocket, 4 others to list
summary: India’s IPO market enters another busy week, with five companies set to raise Rs 5,499.32 crore between August 17 and 21. Horizon Industrial Parks leads fundraising, while five recently completed IPOs, including Shiprocket, are scheduled to list.

title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
summary: The Sensex fell 490 points over five sessions through August 14, while 23 BSE 500 stocks declined daily. Eleven stocks dropped more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah and Techno Electric & Engineering.

title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| Where is the value? Sachin Bajaj favours financials, healthcare, capex plays
summary: Axis Max Life CIO Sachin Bajaj sees Indian equities entering a favourable phase as earnings recover, valuations moderate and domestic flows remain strong. He favours financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms and manufacturing beneficiaries, while cautioning against expensive stocks.

title: Adani Enterprises, HDFC Bank among 10 stocks with highest increase in mutual fund holdings in value terms
summary: Mutual funds increased holdings in 10 leading Indian companies during the June quarter, with ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank seeing the largest value additions. All 10 stocks gained, led by Adani Enterprises, InterGlobe Aviation and Bajaj Finance during the quarter.

title: ETMarkets Management Talk| MAN Industries eyes bigger Saudi footprint; region could contribute 35–40% of revenue in 3 years: Nikhil Mansukhani
summary: MAN Industries expects Saudi Arabia to become a major growth driver, contributing 35–40% of revenue within three years. The company is targeting FY27 revenue of ₹5,000 crore, backed by Saudi expansion, Dammam facility and Jammu’s seamless pipe plant.

title: Nifty at risk below 24,000; MCX, Havells among stocks to watch next week: Rupak De
summary: Nifty faces a crucial 24,000 support level after weakening momentum, with a break potentially triggering short-term bearishness. Analyst Rupak De favours auto and PSU banks, while highlighting MCX, ELGI Equipments, Havells and Himadri Speciality Chemical as trading opportunities.

title: Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?
summary: Four companies—Reliance Industries, Hindustan Unilever, ITC and Larsen & Toubro—have been part of the Sensex since inception, reflecting India’s evolving economy. Their journeys span decades of transformation, with vastly different recent performances but enduring relevance in the Indian market.

title: Buy HDFC Bank; target of Rs 1,850: ICICI Securities
